page.layout: One printed page, title page. Full-width title block at top; below it a woodcut device with a seal impression to its right; imprint line at the bottom. Handwritten annotations and a pencil shelf mark are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: Adiectus est in calce geminus Index: quorum
prior est Locorum S. Scripturæ: poste-

page.notes: Woodcut device (a figure with three heads on a column) and a circular seal impression between the Adiectus block and the imprint; not transcribed. Handwritten inscriptions ("Joh. ... haerede ipsius ... Hortinus e filio Samuele", "Nunc Jacobi Hortini Johannis Pronepotis, Anno 1685") and a pencilled shelf mark "Thun clt 432" are not printed and are omitted. Some words in the title are uncertain where the scan is blurred, notably "Sacrę" and "VVOLFG ANGV M"; these are as seen.
